# UI worker: viewer clarity (graph executor marks, created files with findings, output-first node pages, findings by reviewer)

Implement the `ui` half of `docs/PRD_VIEWER_CLARITY.md`. Read its sections 1, 2 and 4.2 to 4.5 as the specification and section 6 as the test list. The PRD's section 4.1 pins the exact result shape the adapter lane is landing at the same time (artifact kind `file` with `path`, `files_not_captured` with its four reasons, `contract_version` unchanged at `1.0.0`); build your fixtures from that paragraph and from `contracts/workflow/workerResult.schema.json` as it exists in your worktree, and do not read the adapter lane's worktree or copy anything from it. If the PRD is ambiguous, choose, state the choice as an open assumption in your completion summary, and keep going.

## Ownership

Only edit `src/projects/` and `tests/project-workflows/`. The adapter worker owns `workflow/`, `contracts/`, `server/` and `features/project-workflows/`; do not edit them. Do not edit `features/viewer-clarity/`, `docs/`, package manifests, `src/App.*`, `src/index.css`, `src/document/` or the root Playwright configuration; the dashed node outline is an inline SVG attribute toggled by a class, not a stylesheet rule. Do not commit or push.

## Deliverables

1. Executor marks (PRD 4.3): `EXECUTOR_LABEL` and `executorOf` in `src/projects/status.ts`; in `src/projects/WorkflowGraph.tsx` the class `is-agent` or `is-controller` on every node, a dashed outline on controller and verifier nodes, the executor in the meta line and in the accessible name, and a legend with three entries (`data-testid="graph-legend"`); an "Executed by" fact in `NodeDetail.tsx`. Review nodes say one session per reviewer, or one print job per reviewer when the served review result's transport is `print`.
2. Launch versus verify pages (PRD 4.2): split `WorkerEvidence` in `src/projects/NodeDetail.tsx` into the produced view (result facts, created files, completion signal, launch receipt, task) for launch nodes and the verified view (result facts, checks with logs, gate and deferred checks, screenshots, other artifacts, ownership outcome) for verify nodes. Neither repeats the other's block.
3. Created files (PRD 4.2): a "Files created or changed" section on the launch node listing every `changed_files` entry; entries with a `file` artifact render inline for `.md` through `src/document/Markdown.tsx` (import it, do not modify it) and behind a disclosure as source for other text; `files_not_captured` entries show their reason; a result with neither says files were not captured for this run.
4. Task disclosure (PRD 4.2): the task panel inside a closed `<details data-testid="task-details">` after the result and files; it opens automatically when a finding's requirement link hands over a quote, and the existing highlight and scroll still work.
5. Findings on files (PRD 4.4): `findingsForFile` and `linesNamed` in `src/projects/findings.ts` (verbatim path match only; `path:N` and `path:N-M` ranges); a "Findings on this file" list on each captured file's panel with a "show lines" control that switches to the source view, marks the lines with `data-finding-line` and scrolls the first into view; a link from each review finding that names a captured file to that file's panel on the launch node.
6. Findings by reviewer (PRD 4.5): the `reviewer` grouping in `src/projects/ReviewDetail.tsx`, groups in declared order labelled with the reviewer id, its verdict and severity counts; default grouping `reviewer` when the run has more than one reviewer, `disposition` otherwise; the reviewer filter composes with every grouping.
7. Fixtures and seeds: a new run in `tests/project-workflows/fixtures.ts` whose worker result carries a `file` artifact for a Markdown file and one for a `.ts` file, a `too_large` and a `binary` entry in `files_not_captured`, and review findings whose messages name those files with and without line ranges plus one naming a similar but different path; keep a legacy run without any of it; `tests/project-workflows/seed.ts` writes the same packets and artifacts as real run directories for the candidate phase. Existing runs and scenarios stay untouched.
8. Browser scenarios, one test per policy scenario id, each title containing `[scenario:<id>]`: `executor-marks`, `created-file-rendered`, `output-first-task-collapsed`, `verify-shows-checks-not-files`, `findings-on-files`, `findings-by-reviewer`, asserting exactly what PRD section 6 lists, in both phases. Extend `finding-to-task` for the disclosure rather than duplicating it. Keep `candidate-evidence`, `deferred-checks`, `viewer-two-reviewers`, `legacy-run` and `paths-redacted` passing.

## Verification

Run in this worktree before signalling completion: `npm run build`, `npm run test:unit`, and the project-workflows browser suite with `WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=worker` and with `WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=candidate` (see `features/project-workflows/README.md`). Until the adapter's schema lands, the build and the candidate-phase browser run may fail on the missing `file` kind: report that honestly with the exact error; the controller reruns the build and browser checks on the combined candidate and gates on them there. Report every check you ran with its result.

# Adapter worker: viewer clarity (capture created files as evidence; serve them)

Implement the `adapter` half of `docs/PRD_VIEWER_CLARITY.md`. Read its sections 1, 2 and 4.1 as the specification and the adapter rows of section 6 as the test list. Section 4.1 pins the result shape exactly; the ui lane is building its fixtures against that paragraph at the same time, so implement it as written and record any deviation as an open assumption in your completion summary. Do not read the ui lane's worktree.

## Ownership

Only edit `workflow/`, `contracts/`, `server/` and `features/project-workflows/`. The UI worker owns `src/projects/` and `tests/project-workflows/`; do not edit them. Do not edit `features/viewer-clarity/`, `docs/`, package manifests, `src/` or the root Playwright configuration. Do not commit or push.

## Deliverables

1. Capture (PRD 4.1) in `workflow/checks.py` `verify_revision`: in the `worker` phase only, after the verification worktree is confirmed clean at the snapshot commit and before `run_lane_commands`, capture every path in `changed` that exists as a regular file, is text (decodes as UTF-8, no NUL byte) and fits the caps, as an artifact of kind `file` with its repo-relative `path`; list every other path in `files_not_captured` with reason `binary`, `too_large`, `missing` or `budget`. Caps are named constants: 512 KiB per file, 8 MiB per packet. The candidate phase captures nothing and lists nothing.
2. Contract in `contracts/workflow/workerResult.schema.json`, unchanged `contract_version` `1.0.0`: `file` in the artifact kind enum; optional `path` on artifacts, required exactly when kind is `file`, repo-relative with no `..` segment and no leading `/`; optional `files_not_captured: [{path, reason}]` with the four reasons. Mirror it in `contracts/workflow/v1.ts` and export; update `contracts/workflow/README.md`, `contracts/projects/README.md`, `examples.ts` and `contract.test.ts` in both families. A result without the new fields stays valid.
3. `recheck_packet` verifies `file` artifacts against their retained bytes like every other artifact; a mismatch fails the packet.
4. `server/projects.ts` and `server/projects.test.ts`: the served worker result passes `file` artifacts with `path` and `files_not_captured` through unchanged; a result recorded without them still validates; the artifact route serves a captured file with a text content type.
5. Tests in `workflow/test_checks.py` or `workflow/test_verification.py` for PRD section 6 `capture-text-files`, `capture-before-checks` and `tampered-file-artifact`, and in `server/projects.test.ts` for `served-files`.
6. Docs: `workflow/RUNBOOK.md` and `workflow/CHEATSHEET.md` describe the captured files, the caps and the reasons; `features/project-workflows/README.md` notes the new evidence in the viewer.

## Verification

Run in this worktree before signalling completion: the workflow unit suite (`.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s workflow -t .` from the repository root), `npm run test:contracts`, `npm run test:unit` and `npm run build`. Report every check you ran with its result.
